hotels.title: South Island Oceanfront Oasis in Kaikōura with Onsite Restaurant & Heated Pool
hotels.description: Perfectly positioned on the stunning shoreline of Kaikōura on New Zealand's South Island, this sophisticated retreat offers breathtaking views where mountains meet the sea. Just a short stroll from the town centre, you'll be perfectly placed to enjoy the region's world-renowned marine adventures, from whale watching to swimming with dolphins, plus coastal walks and famed seafood. Indulge in modern dining at Hiku restaurant, showcasing the best produce of the region, from land to sea. Between encounters with Kaikōura's natural beauty, take a dip in the hotel's outdoor lap pool or keep up with your routine at the fitness centre. Then, return to your private sanctuary where floor-to-ceiling windows flood the space with light.
